improvements: Refreshed the complete real mall footprint and retained its source concavities in polygon collision.
Kept Bellevue Square as its own explicitly owned source building; removed the separate invented bridge-landing block from the Lincoln model.
Exact Macy’s part identity now shares the low mall envelope, removing the unsupported57.6m generic tower without moving source footprints.
Recessed entrance glass and a roof-supported concrete gable follow a CC0 April2023 photograph; facade dimensions remain explicit estimates.
remainingGaps: Mall roof equipment, individual entrances, loading areas, facade subdivisions and bridge landing detail remain simplified.
The15 m roof massing remains an estimate rather than a newly established metre height.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.

The shared explicit-ID source-replacement implementation is integrated in production (2c73f3d986a4e52d85f5520ca6cb3d4b732f0d13). These studies retain their actual capture-era source and do not establish current district placement, road/body clearance, traffic/mirror budgets or seasonal parity. Registry entries outside a district list and context-only models with no replacement IDs do not replace neighbouring buildings.
The mall’s15m envelope and21m gable peak are model estimates. Roof equipment, loading frontage and other entrances remain incomplete.
